payload.claim: Acceptance criterion 1 says `read_revert_exempt` answers `[]` for a file older than `baseline.json` whether that stale file is damaged or not, and the suite only tests a stale file holding valid JSON. Moving the freshness check (lines 504-505) to just before the final `return data`, after the open/parse/shape checks instead of before them, keeps every test in `tests/test_package.py::test_the_exemption_reader_answers_for_each_state_of_the_task_directory` green (the one stale case it builds is valid JSON, so it still ends up returning `[]`), but a stale file with invalid JSON, wrong shape, or a directory at the path would now raise `RevertExemptUnreadable` instead of returning `[]`, contradicting the acceptance criterion as rendered satisfied by `criteria: pass`.
